portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.  

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use 
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
Metacity is a simple window manager that integrates with GNOME 2.

Bugs fixed in these updated packages include:

* spurious enter/leave events would be generated when raise-to-click was
not enabled.

* in some cases a required event would not be sent to application causing
delays before windows were shown.

Users are advised to upgrade to apply this update, which resolves these
issues.
